message.content: {"mentions":[{"ref":"m1","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":0},{"ref":"m2","surface":"地保","occurrence":1},{"ref":"m3","surface":"趙太爺","occurrence":2}],"relations":[{"subject_ref":"m1","object_ref":"m2","type":"冲突","evidence":[{"quote":"阿Q並沒有抗辯他確鑿姓趙，只用手摸着左頰，和地保退出去了；外面又被地保訓斥了一番，謝了地保二百文酒錢","occurrence":0}]},{"subject_ref":"m1","object_ref":"m3","type":"冲突","evidence":[{"quote":"卽使眞姓趙，有趙太爺在這裏，也不該如此胡說的","occurrence":3}]}],"alias_proposals":[]}
